name: next-steps
description: After each turn, offers a few suggested next prompts above the prompt box; pick one to fill the box, or dismiss them

useModel.title: Ask a small model for suggestions
useModel.description: After each turn, make one small, cheap model call to suggest next steps. It uses a little of your usage. Off, you only get this repo's built-in steps for the taxonomy loop.

model.title: Model for suggestions
model.description: An alias such as haiku, or a full model id.

maxSuggestions.title: How many suggestions
maxSuggestions.description: The most suggestions to show (1 to 4).

projectHint.title: About this project
projectHint.description: A sentence or two the suggestion model reads, so its suggestions fit your project.
projectHint.default: This repo is a startup-opportunity taxonomy. taxonomy.yaml is the single source of truth, and the loop is: snapshot it into source/, edit it, make validate, log the change in reports/changelog.md, make reconcile, then make build.
